sentences.en: In the summer, particularly early in the summer, I felt myself hitting the stage of the pandemic where I was mourning live music.
sentences.zh: 在夏天，特别是初夏时，我感到自己正经历疫情中的那个阶段，我在为现场音乐默哀。

sentences.en: I live in Columbus, Ohio, and summer here is kind of concert season traditionally.
sentences.zh: 我住在俄亥俄州哥伦布市，这里的夏天传统上可以说是演唱会季节。

sentences.en: The outdoor venues open up, more bands come through.
sentences.zh: 户外场馆开放，更多的乐队来到这里。

sentences.en: It is an experience that I think really defines the kind of emotional arc of the summer.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一段真正定义了夏天情感弧光的经历。

sentences.en: Some bands come at the beginning of the summer to really set things off and some come at the end to really tie it up in a bow.
sentences.zh: 有些乐队在初夏到来以真正拉开序幕，有些则在夏末到来以真正画上圆满的句号。

sentences.en: And so the beginning of the summer, I found myself kind of aching for that kind of interaction,
sentences.zh: 所以在初夏时分，我发现自己渴望那种互动，

sentences.en: but also confronting the reality that I don't know when I'll ever feel comfortable going to a live show again, you know.
sentences.zh: 但也面对着这样的现实：我不知道自己什么时候才能再次自在地去看一场现场演出，你知道的。

sentences.en: and i was thinking too about the collaborative nature of live music and how the audience are effectively collaborators with whoever is on stage trying to reach a kind of
sentences.zh: 我也在思考现场音乐的合作本质，以及观众实际上如何与台上的任何人进行合作，试图达成一种

sentences.en: shared set of emotions and this kind of emotional rabbit hole took me to gillian welch and david
sentences.zh: 共同的情感，这种情感的兔子洞把我带到了吉莉安·韦尔奇和大卫

sentences.en: Rawlings, who are maybe the greatest collaborators in contemporary music.
sentences.zh: 罗林斯面前，他们也许是当代音乐中最伟大的合作者。

sentences.en: And I wanted to go see them in Nashville, this loud, cacophonous music city that is kind of startled into silence.
sentences.zh: 我想去纳什维尔看他们，这座嘈杂、刺耳的音乐之城因某种原因被惊吓得陷入沉默。

sentences.en: But I think through our conversation, the one thing I left with was this sense of optimism that I don't normally feel.
sentences.zh: 但我认为通过我们的交谈，我带走的一点是那种我平时感受不到的乐观主义。

sentences.en: I'm not normally an immensely optimistic person.
sentences.zh: 我通常不是一个极其乐观的人。

sentences.en: I am, some would say, averse to optimism, but there was something about Gillian and Dave's commitment to a reality
sentences.zh: 有人会说，我排斥乐观，但吉莉安和戴夫对现实的这种承诺有些特别之处

sentences.en: that could be altered by song, or that could be altered by storytelling.
sentences.zh: 这种现实可以通过歌曲改变，或者可以通过讲故事改变。

sentences.en: These are two really optimistic people, optimistic people who have a specific lens on the country in some ways,
sentences.zh: 这两个人非常乐观，他们对这个国家有着某种特定视角的乐观，

sentences.en: because they grew up singing songs that were from various perspectives that were often not hers.
sentences.zh: 因为他们唱着来自各种不同视角的歌曲长大，而这些视角往往不是女性的。

sentences.en: and so she knows how to write a song that gets to the heart of these themes like love and loss
sentences.zh: 所以她知道如何写一首触及爱与失落这些主题核心的歌，

sentences.en: and death and fear and she knows how to extract the right emotions out of them and there's an
sentences.zh: 以及死亡和恐惧，她知道如何从中提取出正确的情感，

sentences.en: optimism in that too i think there's an optimism in knowing how to get to the heart of themes that
sentences.zh: 其中也有一种乐观，我认为知道如何触及主题的核心是一种乐观，

sentences.en: people can feel even if they don't want to so i hope you enjoy my story this is hard times
sentences.zh: 人们即使不想去感受也能感觉得到，所以我希望你喜欢我的故事，这是艰难时期

sentences.en: Read by Janina Edwards.
sentences.zh: 由雅尼娜·爱德华兹朗读。

sentences.zh: 立即下载《时报》应用程序并获得 30 天免费访问权限。

sentences.en: As we enter yet another season of our individual and collective loneliness, it feels almost cruel to reminisce about the power of live music.
sentences.zh: 当我们进入个人与集体孤独的又一个季节时，回顾现场音乐的力量几乎显得有些残酷。

sentences.en: But if, in some before time, you were lucky enough to see Gillian Welch and David
sentences.zh: 但是如果在某个从前的时代，你足够幸运能亲眼看到吉莉安·韦尔奇和戴夫

sentences.en: Rawlings live, you most likely experience the feeling of homecoming that two performers who genuinely love being on stage together can bestow on an eager audience.
sentences.zh: 罗林斯的现场演出，你很可能会体验到一种回家的感觉，两个真心喜欢一起同台演出的表演者能够赋予急切的观众这种感觉。

sentences.en: Welch and Rawlings have been singing together since the early 90s.
sentences.zh: 韦尔奇和罗林斯从 90 年代初就开始一起唱歌了。

sentences.en: I wanted to see if the sun was down yet.
sentences.zh: 我想看看太阳是不是已经落山了。

sentences.en: We don't really dip into the truly dark and pitiful numbers until.
sentences.zh: 直到那些真正黑暗和可悲的曲子出现前，我们其实不会涉足太深。

sentences.en: And on stage.
sentences.zh: 而在舞台上。

sentences.en: We got a little while to go.
sentences.zh: 我们还有一会儿时间。

sentences.en: Each can discern what the other needs with just a quick exchange of glances or the tap of a foot.
sentences.zh: 只需一个快速的眼神交流或轻轻跺一下脚，彼此就能看出对方需要什么。

sentences.en: That That level of trust extends outward, drawing the audience into a tight circle of intimacy.
sentences.zh: 这种信任程度向外延伸，将观众拉入一个紧密的亲密圈子中。

sentences.en: Welch sings with her entire face.
sentences.zh: 韦尔奇用她的整个面部在歌唱。

sentences.en: When a song bends toward joy, she almost can't help smiling.
sentences.zh: 当一首歌倾向于欢乐时，她几乎情不自禁地微笑。

sentences.en: And when a song bends toward sorrow, she looks contemplative, sometimes heartbroken, sometimes resigned to whatever the song's fate may be.
sentences.zh: 而当一首歌倾向于悲伤时，她看起来若有所思，有时心碎，有时听天由命，任由这首歌的命运如何。

sentences.en: but her voice is consistent and clear always
sentences.zh: 但她的声音始终坚定而清晰

sentences.en: it resonates in the heart first she sings as though she's either mourning or preparing to mourn rawlings is the more animated of the two he's tall and athletic and energized
sentences.zh: 它首先在心底产生共鸣，她歌唱时就像是在哀悼或准备哀悼，罗林斯是两人中更活跃的一个，他身材高大、体格健美且充满活力，当他弹吉他时，他的整个上半身在细微但猛烈的动作中扭动着

sentences.en: when he plays his guitar his entire upper body twists and turns in small but ferocious movements
sentences.zh: 当他弹奏吉他时，他整个上半身在细小而激烈的动作中扭动。

sentences.en: their combined voices operate beyond simple sonic harmony there are emotional inquiries at play
sentences.zh: 他们结合的声音超越了简单的声音和声，其中蕴含着情感的探索

sentences.en: if welsh's voice delivers the good news or the hard news of the world rawling's voice comes underneath asking how much deeper the sadness can go
sentences.zh: 如果韦尔奇的声音传递了世界的好消息或坏消息，罗林斯的声音则在下方响起，询问悲伤究竟能延伸到多深

sentences.en: or what fresh heights the ecstatic can climb to i saw them in virginia in the fall of 2018 at an
sentences.zh: 或者狂喜能攀登到什么样的新高度，我在 2018 年秋天的弗吉尼亚州看过他们的演出，那是一场断断续续伴有风暴的户外演出。

sentences.en: outdoor show that was intermittently stormy.
sentences.zh: 一场断断续续有风暴的户外演出。

sentences.en: A crowd of a few hundred people descended on a wide field, our feet sinking into the muddy grass.
sentences.zh: 几百名观众涌入一片开阔的田野，我们的双脚陷入泥泞的草地中。

sentences.en: About halfway into their set, they gave a performance of the song Hard Times that has been worked into my memory.
sentences.zh: 在他们演出进行到大约一半时，他们演唱了《艰难时期》这首歌，这首歌已深深嵌入我的记忆中。

sentences.en: The tune is, on its surface, about overcoming the world's ills.
sentences.zh: 从表面上看，这曲子是关于克服世界的苦难。

sentences.en: A man plows and sings to his mule until he stops plowing, and one day the mule is gone.
sentences.zh: 一个男人耕地并对他的骡子唱歌，直到他停止耕地，而有一天骡子不见了。

sentences.en: It's a patient and heartbreaking song,
sentences.zh: 这是一首耐人寻味且令人心碎的歌，

sentences.en: filtered through a vague but believable promise of something better, especially when played live.
sentences.zh: 通过对美好事物某种模糊却可信的承诺进行过滤，特别是在现场演奏时。

sentences.en: It feels as if you're nursing an open wound that is slowly stitching itself closed, inch by inch.
sentences.zh: 感觉就像你在护理一个正在一寸一寸慢慢愈合的开放性伤口。

sentences.en: As they sang, the rain started to fall, and the audience gathered closer to one another while the mud rose around us.
sentences.zh: 当他们唱歌时，雨开始下了起来，泥浆在我们四周上涨，观众们彼此靠得更近了。

sentences.en: Welch handled the first two-thirds of hard times on her own, picking along on a banjo, laying out the facts of the landscape and the characters upon it.
sentences.zh: 韦尔奇独自完成了《艰难时期》前三分之二的演唱，她弹着班卓琴，摆出大地的风景及其上面的角色。

sentences.en: Rawlings stood slightly behind her, swaying silently, maybe plucking a guitar string or two.
sentences.zh: 罗林斯微微站在她身后，默默摇晃着，或许拨弄了一两下吉他弦。

sentences.en: He showed an almost visible restraint, vibrating with anticipation.
sentences.zh: 他表现出几乎肉眼可见的克制，因期待而微微颤抖。

sentences.en: Then Welch's line,
sentences.zh: 然后韦尔奇的歌词是，

sentences.en: We all get to heaven in our own sweet time, seemed to activate Rawlings, transforming the song from a distant but touchable story into immediate instructions for a listener
sentences.zh: 我们都以各自美妙的方式进入天堂，这似乎激活了罗林斯，将这首歌从一个遥远但触手可及的故事转变为对听众的直接指示

sentences.en: who might be ruled by some anguish and looking to get free.
sentences.zh: 可能被某种痛苦控制并渴望获得自由的人。

sentences.en: Kick till the dust comes up
sentences.zh: 踢直到尘土飞扬

sentences.en: When they hit the line, and kick till the dust comes up from the cracks in the floor,
sentences.zh: 当他们唱到这句歌词时，尘土从地板的裂缝中飞扬起来，

sentences.en: They lifted their feet simultaneously on the word up and instinctively brought them down at the same time.
sentences.zh: 他们在唱到“up”这个词时同时抬起双脚，并凭直觉在同一时刻落脚。

sentences.en: That is the magic of their performance, making the small moments romantic.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们表演的魅力所在，让微小的时刻变得浪漫。

sentences.en: They sing as though they're letting you in on a secret that might not save your life forever, but will definitely save it in that moment.
sentences.zh: 他们唱歌时，仿佛在向你吐露一个秘密，这个秘密或许无法永远拯救你的生命，但绝对能在那个时刻拯救你。

sentences.en: I miss the performances of songs
sentences.zh: 我想念那些歌曲的演出

sentences.en: that feel like the birth of entire planets.
sentences.zh: 感觉就像整个星球的诞生。

sentences.en: With Welch and Rawlings, you could get that feeling five, six times a night.
sentences.zh: 有了韦尔奇和罗林斯，你一个晚上能有五六次这种感觉。

sentences.en: When I met Welch and Rawlings in August, they were as warm as their shows have led me to expect.
sentences.zh: 八月我见到韦尔奇和罗林斯时，他们和他们的演出让我预期的那样热情。

sentences.en: But there was a tentativeness, too, as we positioned ourselves more than six feet apart to talk.
sentences.zh: 但也有种试探，当我们保持六英尺以上的距离站着交谈时。

sentences.en: Welch and Rawlings, like myself and many others, hadn't interacted with too many people during the spring and summer.
sentences.zh: 韦尔奇和罗林斯，就像我自己和许多其他人一样，在春夏季节没有和太多人互动过。

sentences.en: We were standing in a giant room inside Woodland Studios, the duo's home base in East Nashville, a neighborhood hit hard by a tornado that ripped through the city in March,
sentences.zh: 我们站在林地录音室（Woodland Studios）内部一个巨大的房间里，这是这对组合在东纳什维尔的大本营，这个社区在三月份被席卷该市的龙卷风严重破坏，

sentences.en: right before the pandemic confined much of the country to our homes.
sentences.zh: 就在大流行将全国大部分地区限制在家中之前。

sentences.en: If you look up, Welch said, indicating a ceiling haphazardly patched with what seemed to be wood, you can see where we had no roof.
sentences.zh: 如果你抬头看，韦尔奇说，指着一个似乎用木头拼凑修补的乱七八糟的天花板，你可以看到我们曾经没有屋顶的地方。

sentences.en: The building had once been the Woodland Theater, before becoming a studio where Emmylou Harris, Johnny Cash, and Willie Nelson,
sentences.zh: 这座建筑曾经是林地剧院（Woodland Theater），后来变成了一个录音室，埃米卢·哈里斯、约翰尼·卡什和威利·纳尔逊等人在

sentences.en: among others, rolled out folk and country hits at a rapid pace.
sentences.zh: 其中，以极快的速度推出了民谣和乡村热门歌曲。

sentences.en: Rawlings and Welch, who are also a couple, bought the building about two decades ago, after it was nearly destroyed by a different tornado, and then condemned by the city.
sentences.zh: 罗林斯和韦尔奇也是一对情侣，大约二十年前买下了这座建筑，当时它几乎被另一场龙卷风完全摧毁，随后被城市判定为危房。

sentences.en: Welch, wearing all black, including her mask, walked gingerly through the space, as if she were seeing it again with fresh eyes, and calmly laid out the damage.
sentences.zh: 韦尔奇一身黑衣，戴着口罩，小心翼翼地穿过这个空间，仿佛她带着全新的目光再次看到这里，并平静地指出了受损情况。

sentences.en: In March, Welch and Rawlings ran through the storm from their nearby house to the now roofless studio to rescue their equipment and, more important, their master recordings.
sentences.zh: 三月，韦尔奇和罗林斯冒着风暴从他们附近的房子跑到如今没有屋顶的录音室，去抢救他们的设备，更重要的是，抢救他们的母带录音。

sentences.en: As the rain poured in, they had to keep moving things around for nearly 10 hours, boxes of recordings, rolling crates full of guitars.
sentences.zh: 倾盆大雨中，他们不得不连续近 10 个小时不断搬运东西，一箱箱的录音带、装满吉tr的滚动箱子。

sentences.en: There was no power and no cell service at the time.
sentences.zh: 当时没有电力，也没有手机信号。

sentences.en: No way to reach out to anyone else.
sentences.zh: 没有办法联系任何人。

sentences.en: It was just the two of them and a friend who was living in the studio's apartment, trying to save what they could, illuminating the darkness with dying flashlights.
sentences.zh: 只有他们两个和一位住在录音室公寓里的朋友，试图挽救他们能挽救的一切，用快要没电的手电筒照亮黑暗。

sentences.en: Dave and I have literally, physically saved every piece of our world,
sentences.zh: 戴夫和我字面意义上、身体力行地拯救了我们世界的每一部分，

sentences.en: Welch said.
sentences.zh: 韦尔奇说。

sentences.en: And it begs the question, why did I save this?
sentences.zh: 这就引发了一个问题，我为什么要拯救这个？

sentences.en: What is the value of this?
sentences.zh: 这有什么价值？

sentences.en: What did I intend to do with this?
sentences.zh: 我对这个有什么打算？

sentences.en: Her voice was hushed and contemplative, as if she were no longer speaking to me, but to herself.
sentences.zh: 她的声音低沉而沉思，仿佛她不再是对我说话，而是在自言自语。

sentences.en: Did I think all of this was just going to be safe forever?
sentences.zh: 难道我以为这一切都会永远安然无恙吗？

sentences.en: For the duo, the months after the tornado and the pandemic struck led, perhaps unexpectedly, to an increased output.
sentences.zh: 对这对组合来说，龙卷风和大流行爆发后的几个月，或许出人意料地带来了产量的大幅增加。

sentences.en: They released All the Good Times, an album of old folk songs at the start of July, and they will spend the rest of the year releasing Boots 2, The Lost Songs,
sentences.zh: 他们在七月初发行了一张老民谣专辑《All the Good Times》，并且将在今年剩下的时间里发行《靴子 2：失落的歌曲》（Boots 2, The Lost Songs），

sentences.en: a three-volume collection of recordings that were rescued from the flooded studio.
sentences.zh: 这是一个三卷集的录音合集，是从被淹没的录音室中抢救出来的。

sentences.en: The first volume was released in the middle of July.
sentences.zh: 第一卷于七月中旬发行。

sentences.en: It is unlike Welch and Rawlings to push this much music into the world in a single burst,
sentences.zh: 韦尔奇和罗林斯在一阵中推出如此多的音乐是不寻常的，

sentences.en: 58 songs in half a year, which is seven more than those on Welch's five studio albums combined.
sentences.zh: 半年内 58 首歌，这比韦尔奇五张录音室专辑加起来的歌曲还要多出七首。

sentences.en: But with a country careering toward new depths of uncertainty,
sentences.zh: 但随着一个国家正朝着不确定性的新深渊疾驰，

sentences.en: Welch and Rawlings have discovered a new emotional urgency.
sentences.zh: 韦尔奇和罗林斯发现了新的一种情感紧迫感。

sentences.en: They are once again returning to what they know.
sentences.zh: 他们再次回到了他们所熟知的东西。

sentences.en: Songs about the slow, challenging, beautiful heat of living.
sentences.zh: 关于生活的缓慢、具有挑战性、美丽的热度的歌曲。

sentences.en: About people having to make hard decisions on a path to goodness.
sentences.zh: 关于人们在通往善良的道路上必须做出艰难决定的歌曲。

sentences.en: Gillian writes in a way that sounds like she's from the 1800s.
